Glossary / Shareholder
Glossary · Corporate finance

Shareholder शेयरधारक

A person or institution that owns shares in a company and so holds part of its ownership.

हिंदी में: शेयरधारक

कंपनी के शेयर रखने वाला व्यक्ति या संस्था, जो उसके स्वामित्व में हिस्सेदार होता है।

How it is used in the lessons

Limited liability: as a shareholder you can lose the money you invested, but you are not responsible for the company's debts beyond that amount.

From Stock Market Foundations

Corporate governance report: board composition, committees, remuneration and shareholder complaints.
